summary: Context-only committee read: the world state is mixed, with growth stress receding but no all-clear because the dominant rates/inflation pressure remains elevated. The confirmed Q2/Reflation label has only 0.02 confidence and its own raw axes point toward Q1; restrictive rising real yields, a bear steepener, confirmed credit stress, neutral-hollow liquidity, poor breadth and a safety-driven dollar conflict with the benign interpretation. Leadership remains intact, volatility is normalizing and the measured caution-state 21-day drawdown rate is not above base, so this is a contradiction-rich attention regime rather than a directional forecast. No signal, ranking, sizing instruction or trade is originated.
